title: Power torsion in the raw resolution restriction kernel
statement: Let f:X→T be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], F a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], I an injective resolution of F, q a natural number, W an affine open of T and a in Γ(T,W). Let K=f_*I and P=sectionCohomologyPresheaf(K,q) [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Write res:P(W)→P(D(a)) for its canonical restriction. For every x in P(W), if res(x)=0 then there is n≥0 with a^n x=0. This asserts no lifting of classes in P(D(a)).

source.place: Lemma 30.17.3, tensor-unit specialization, torsion part; Tag 01E4, Lemma 20.7.3, section complexes.

proof.text: Set Y=f⁻¹W and b=f^♯a. The affineness of W and qcqs hypotheses on f give a qcqs scheme Y. The restriction of F is quasi-coherent and that of I is injective. The sections of the restricted resolution on Y and D(b)=f⁻¹D(a) are the section complexes K(W) and K(D(a)). Taking homology identifies their cohomology with P(W) and P(D(a)). These degreewise identifications commute with restriction and multiplication by functions, so their homology identifications do also.

Apply invertS_cohomology on Y with tensor unit and section b. Its canonical equation at exponent zero identifies the image of [0,x] with restriction of x. The hypothesis makes this image zero, so injectivity of the comparison makes [0,x]=0 in the fraction presentation.

Apply cohomologyFraction_eventually_zero at numerator index zero. It gives a later tensor transition killing x. Under the tensor-unit identifications this transition is multiplication by b^n. Transporting through the section-complex identification gives a^n x=0. For a=0 take n=1; for unit a restriction is an isomorphism and n=0 works. Degree zero, empty W and zero coefficients are included.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 30.17.3 and Tag 01E4; explicit extraction of the torsion part by Q2.

lean.statement:
theorem sectionCohomologyPresheaf_pow_annihilates {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (I : InjectiveResolution F) (q : ℕ)
    (W : T.Opens) (hW : IsAffineOpen W) (a : Γ(T, W)) :
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q
    ∀ x : P.obj (op W), (P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom x = 0 →
      ∃ n : ℕ, a ^ n • x = 0
